question: Give the distribution of answers to `dp_cor_so_standard` across all 14 agreements as an object mapping every standard option of that deal point (include options with count 0) to the number of agreements (each agreement counts once).

Give the distribution of answers to `dp_cor_ie_standard` across all 14 agreements as an object mapping every standard option of that deal point (include options with count 0) to the number of agreements (each agreement counts once).
How many of the 14 agreements satisfy ALL of the following: `dp_ie_knowledge_mgmt` = «No» AND NOT (`dp_cor_match_initial` = «3 business days»)? Answer with an integer.
How many of the 14 agreements satisfy ALL of the following: `dp_ie_materiality` = «Yes» AND NOT (`dp_ftr_match_initial` = «5 business days»)? Answer with an integer.

How many of the 14 agreements satisfy ALL of the following: `dp_fidout_standard` = «"Inconsistent" with fiduciary duties» AND NOT (`dp_ftr_limitations` includes «Material breach of no-shop resulting in a Superior Offer»)? Answer with an integer.

List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_ie_knowledge` = «Not known and not reasonably foreseeable at signing» AND NOT (`dp_cor_so_standard` = «"Inconsistent" with fiduciary duties»). If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].

List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_ie_after_signing` = «May occur or arise prior to signing» AND `dp_cor_match_initial` = «3 business days». If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].

List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_cor_match_additional` = «3 business days» AND `dp_ftr_limitations` includes «(Material) breach of other provisions of agreement». If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].

List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_ie_after_signing` = «Must occur or arise after signing» AND `dp_ftr_match_initial` = «5 business days». If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].
List every agreement that satisfies: NOT (`dp_cor_so_standard` gives the same answer as `dp_fidout_standard`). If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].
Which agreement(s) have the highest value of the number of options selected for `dp_ftr_limitations` (not counting 'No')? List all tied agreements.
For `dp_fidout_standard`, list every agreement whose answer is shared by at most 1 of the 14 agreements (counting the agreement itself).
For `dp_cor_ie_standard`, list every agreement whose answer is shared by at most 2 of the 14 agreements (counting the agreement itself).

Consider the deal points `dp_ie_materiality`, `dp_ie_knowledge`, `dp_ie_after_signing`, `dp_ie_knowledge_mgmt`, `dp_cor_ie_standard`, `dp_cor_so_standard`, `dp_fidout_standard`, `dp_cor_match_initial`, `dp_cor_match_additional`, `dp_ftr_match_initial`. For each of them, take the most common answer across the 14 agreements (complete answer; for each listed deal point the most common answer is unique). List every agreement whose answer differs from that most common answer on at least 7 of these deal points.

Considering only `dp_ie_knowledge`, `dp_fidout_trigger`, `dp_cor_match_initial`: group together agreements whose answers are identical on every one of these deal points. Report every group with two or more agreements, as a list of lists of agreement ids (agreements with a unique combination are omitted).
answer_type: list of lists of agreement ids
